item.title: Orca — An Agent Development Environment for Running Agents in Parallel
item.description: An open-source ADE that isolates CLI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex into separate git worktrees so they can run at once. Install, the worktree dependency problem, the Orca CLI, and where it gets uncomfortable on cost and security.
